passage.label: Reached story honored guests Abraham; entered said peace answered peace people unknown; went family came fat roasted calf; placed near them said will you not eat; felt apprehension said fear not gave good tidings learned boy; wife approached cry struck face said barren old woman; said thus said your Lord indeed Wise Knowing; Abraham said what business messengers; said sent people criminals; send down stones clay; marked presence Lord transgressors; brought out whoever cities believers; found not within other than single house Muslims; left therein sign fear painful punishment; Moses sent Pharaoh clear authority; turned away supporters said magician madman; took soldiers cast sea blameworthy; Aad sent barren wind; left nothing came upon made disintegrated ruins; Thamud said enjoy yourselves time; insolent command Lord thunderbolt seized looking on; unable arise nor defend; people Noah before defiantly disobedient

arabicExcerpts.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ
فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ
قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ
مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

mainSubject.label: The honoured guests of Abraham entering with peace, greeted in kind as unknown people; his hastening to bring a fat roasted calf placed near them with an invitation to eat; his apprehension met with their reassurance and glad tidings of a learned son; his wife's alarmed cry, face-striking and barren-old-woman declaration answered by their citation of the Wise Knowing Lord's word; Abraham asking their mission, revealed as being sent to criminal people to rain marked clay stones upon transgressors; all believers extracted from those cities leaving only one Muslim household as a sign for those fearing painful punishment; Moses sent to Pharaoh with clear authority but dismissed as magician or madman, then taken with his soldiers and cast into the sea as blameworthy; Aad struck by a barren wind reducing everything to disintegrated ruins; Thamud told to enjoy themselves for a time but growing insolent toward their Lord's command, seized by a thunderbolt while watching, unable to rise or defend; Noah's people destroyed before them as defiantly disobedient
